newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Technical glitch halts Singapore share trading.
newsitem.headline: Technical glitch halts Singapore share trading.

text.p: Trading at the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) was stalled early Monday morning due to a technical fault at the exchange, dealers said.
According to a broker, no transactions took place after 0110 GMT. SES could not immediately confirm when the technical glitch occurred.
"The technical staff is looking into the problem. At this point of time, I have no details," a spokewoman told Reuters.
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index was at 2,018.96, down 0.64 points prior to the disruption.
Market turnover was around 3.5 million shares.
